observation.command:
cd /workspace && rm -rf .build-logs/stage-frontend && mkdir -p .build-logs/stage-frontend && rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude node_modules --exclude '**/dist' --exclude '**/dist-injector' --exclude .vite --exclude .cache 01-frontend/ .build-logs/stage-frontend/ && du -sh .build-logs/stage-frontend && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p = '.build-logs/stage-frontend/Dockerfile'
txt = open(p).read()
# find the big parallel RUN block (starts with "RUN npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-fp &" and ends with "    wait\n")
start = txt.index('RUN npm run build:release --workspace=mfe-fp &')
end = txt.index('wait', start)
end = txt.index('\n', end) + 1
new = (
"RUN set -e; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-fp mfe-kp; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-mp mfe-verwaltungsakt; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-vp mfe-ws; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    for w in mfe-ewm; do \\\n"
"      npm run build:release --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"      npm run build:injector --workspace=$w & \\\n"
"    done; wait; \\\n"
"    npm run build:release --workspace=shell\n"
)
open(p,'w').write(txt[:start] + new + txt[end:])
print("patched frontend Dockerfile")
EOF
grep -n 'RUN set -e' .build-logs/stage-frontend/Dockerfile | head -2
